elements.name: Verify that the Users list exposes the search, Filters, Sort By and Export CSV controls with their default state

steps.name: I am logged in as an "Admin" user
I am on the "Users" tab
the users list state is reset
the user search, Filters, Sort By and Export CSV controls should be visible
the users grid should be displayed
the total user count should be visible
the Export CSV control should be visible and enabled
I open the Filters panel
the Filters panel should offer Roles and Associated Clinic options

exactly one Sort By option should be selected
